headline: Everyone Just Wants to Sell? The Autumn on the Property Market Has Been Very Interesting So Far
summary: Sellers entered autumn with more momentum than buyers in September. Nearly 150,000 homes were listed for sale on ingatlan.com by month-end, 11% more than a year earlier.
why: Housing listing volumes and the balance between sellers and buyers are watched as indicators of Hungary's residential property market.
